Name: Note
General-in-Chief Luis Acevedo Quintero: Promoted posthumously as the first and only General in Chief from the Air Force
Admiral Ramon Orlando Maniglia Ferreira: First to be promoted to admiral, first-ever Venezuelan three-star admiral in two centuries after Luis Brion
General-in-Chief Gustavo Rangel Briceño: First four-sun promotion for the armed forces
General-in-Chief Carlos José Mata Figuer: Second four-sun promotion for the armed forces, also promoted while being the Chief of the Operational Strategic Command
General-in-Chief Henry Rangel Silva: 2nd to be promoted while in capacity as Commander of the OSC
Admiral-in-Chief Diego Alfredo Molero Be: First Navy four-sun flag officer to be appointed Minister of Defense, 1st to be promoted to Admiral in Chief
Admiral-in-Chief Carmen Meléndez: First woman ever to be promoted to Admiral in Chief and first woman Minister of Defense in Venezuelan history
General-in-Chief Vladimir Padrino López: First to be promoted to General in Chief while being appointed as Commander of the OSC
General-in-Chief Jacinto Pérez Arcay: Oldest living general officer in Venezuelan history to be promoted to the rank
Admiral-in-Chief Francisco de Miranda: In honor of the bicentennial year since his death in prison and the 210th anniversary of his arrival in Venezuela, promoted posthumously
General-in-Chief Gustavo González López: First SEBIN commandant to be promoted
Admiral-in-Chief Remigio Ceballos: 3rd to be promoted to Admiral in Chief and first naval officer to be appointed Commandant of the OSC
